basics.name: Sina Fateh
basics.label: Backend Developer | Software Engineer
basics.about: Software Engineer focused on backend development, API design, software architecture, and reliable server-side systems using Python/Django, while expanding into C# and ASP.NET Core.
basics.summary: Software Engineer with hands-on experience building backend applications, RESTful APIs, authentication and authorization flows, real-time features, caching, testing, and containerized deployments. My main production-style experience is with Python, Django, and Django REST Framework, supported by practical knowledge of PostgreSQL, Redis, Linux, Docker, Nginx, CI/CD, networking, and self-hosted infrastructure. I am currently expanding my backend stack with C# and ASP.NET Core, focusing on Entity Framework Core, dependency injection, SOLID principles, Clean Architecture, Domain-Driven Design, design patterns, testing, and maintainable software architecture. I enjoy understanding how systems are designed, deployed, secured, and operated rather than treating backend development as only writing API endpoints.

projects.name: Pediatric Clinic Platform (Medisite)
projects.description: Developed backend services for a pediatric clinic platform using Django REST Framework. Implemented user registration, JWT authentication, appointment scheduling, blog and content management, and role-based access control for Doctor, Editor, and Patient roles. Added a business rule limiting each patient to one active appointment. Migrated the project database to PostgreSQL, containerized the application with Docker, and deployed it on my own Linux server. Configured Nginx as a reverse proxy, including selective proxy-bypass rules for routes that required direct upstream handling, and managed production DNS and HTTPS access.

projects.name: Private Real-Time Chat Platform
projects.description: Developed and deployed a private real-time messaging platform using Django, Django Channels, ASGI, WebSockets, and PostgreSQL. Implemented authenticated one-to-one messaging, persistent conversation history, username-based private user discovery without exposing a public user directory, and timezone-aware message timestamps. Containerized the application with Docker and deployed it on my own Linux server, using Nginx and reverse proxy configuration to handle production traffic, WebSocket connections, DNS, and HTTPS. The project provided hands-on experience across backend development, real-time communication, database persistence, containerization, and production deployment.

projects.name: Telegram Archive Viewer
projects.description: Developed a self-hosted Telegram archive viewer that parses Telegram Desktop HTML exports, stores normalized message data in SQLite, and provides fast full-text search using FTS5. Implemented authenticated media serving, reply navigation, filtering, and a responsive chat-style UI. Containerized the application with Docker and added automated tests, CI, Dependabot, semantic versioned releases, and GHCR publishing through GitHub Actions, while keeping personal exports and local database files outside the public repository.

projects.name: E-commerce Backend
projects.description: Developed backend APIs for catalog, cart, checkout, and order-management functionality as part of a team project. Implemented JWT authentication and role-based permissions, Redis caching, Celery background tasks, Django signals, and Swagger/OpenAPI documentation. Added unit and integration tests using Pytest, configured GitHub Actions CI, and containerized the application using Docker and PostgreSQL.

projects.name: Resume as Code Platform
projects.description: Developing a JSON-driven personal resume and portfolio platform using Astro and TypeScript. The project uses a single structured JSON source to generate resume content, grouped technical skills, professional experience, education, projects, and profile information. The application is containerized with Docker and Nginx with plans for automated CI/CD deployment through GitHub Actions.

projects.name: Self-Hosted Server & Deployment Infrastructure
projects.description: Built and managed a self-hosted deployment environment for multiple personal web applications on a Linux server. Configured Docker-based services, reverse proxies, DNS records, CDN integration, HTTPS routing, firewall rules, and service isolation. Worked with Nginx, Nginx Proxy Manager, and Arcane to operate and troubleshoot containerized applications, route multiple domains and subdomains, and handle practical deployment issues across the application, network, and infrastructure layers.

projects.name: Arista Exchange Website
projects.description: Developed a modern and responsive website for Arista Exchange, focused on presenting the company, its services, and key information through a clean and user-friendly interface. Built the frontend using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with attention to responsive design, visual consistency, and usability across different screen sizes. Containerized the website with Docker and Nginx, configured automated image builds with GitHub Actions and GHCR, and deployed it on my Linux server through Arcane and the existing reverse proxy infrastructure.

projects.name: Home VPN Gateway
projects.description: Designed and configured a centralized VPN gateway using OpenVPN on Ubuntu Server. Configured Netplan and iptables for routing, traffic forwarding, controlled network access, and network isolation. Implemented encrypted remote connectivity and gained practical experience with Linux networking and infrastructure troubleshooting.
